links.outcome: Clinically relevant errors in LLM-generated anesthesia assessment drafts reviewed by anesthesiologists
links.effect: Thirty-two error instances were identified across the 15 cases, including errors related to proposed plans, ASA physical status classification, and abnormal test interpretation.
links.quote: The LLM-generated drafts were structurally complete but contained clinically relevant errors, mainly in risk assessment and anesthetic plan formulation.

links.outcome: Whether expert review of LLM drafts identifies errors requiring correction before resident-facing use
links.effect: Expert review found 32 error instances across 15 cases; authors conclude expert correction was essential before resident-facing use.
links.quote: In this single-centre exploratory study, an LLM-assisted workflow was feasible for producing preliminary preoperative anesthesia assessment drafts, but expert correction was essential before resident-facing use.

screen.practice: expert correction of LLM drafts before resident use
screen.reason: The study empirically tests an expert-corrected review workflow (a human-in-the-loop deployment safeguard) for LLM-generated preoperative drafts before distributing them to residents, analyzing error patterns and resident perceptions.

primary.practice: expert clinical review and correction before resident use
